    capsys swaps sys.stdout for the main thread. Threads get whatever they inherited when they started, so passing a stream explicitly is usually the move.
  • in coverage says my new dispatch line is never hit but the test definitely goes through it 2026-08-10

    Could also be a TTY difference. Does it hang before the first output line, or after some output appears?
